### Types of "Anti-Hangover" Products

- **Symptom-relief medications:** Over-the-counter options like Alka-Seltzer (aspirin and caffeine) or Blowfish (aspirin and caffeine) target headaches and fatigue, while ginger or antacids address stomach upset.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXWVBBKWdIRlLuyeiql0LRqzbCkcrA14XFZZneY3uI6kevxz50zvZLTsiDmEmiBQUkyKn1XANE72qato5XOkk9jsCISoEPlICHNzCY4_6AdX63wljuevFXfgOmpeAoy7pz09p5XV9u29c3ymvEhfl1VLiw9U-IMqTr)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXMlDBcKe0VzZ8ACv9saMuE744QCw0byR2ZKwDJEX9Dmz0k15Pl4WGiJdr18Yub5K2kraECTWRd_F857WAVmKI1qDIfwhT516IjJ0alYHAakiXo8E17QpjWnpHZFru4QrAEByiDJMFvTPmf6gwSRSo_IpQqaOTuKzsQPE)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXOqCOl5XG4FU6IydT_2fxo4HXQA86f9yP4tb_jklRFPYeJS9yUtgE-4JYBKQl3P_W7m6giljDOLWqrPJkKDLl5TkvuIIO50VzjFpt7axA1pOBp26G0WWsacOeFEPhn8Qu)
- **Supplement blends:** Products such as Myrkl, ZBiotics, Cheers Restore, and Morning Recovery combine vitamins, electrolytes, probiotics, L-cysteine, milk thistle, or dihydromyricetin (DHM). Most lack large, independent clinical trials proving they prevent hangovers or protect the liver.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXLkuFEwtn5HeIpdmNqk_vawte5dEmkdDt3oew8b06dA3B-HQFuoqBF2WpBK3RQM-j1GtKHrXRn7NzPZ3D1uDBqMs0J2CPJY3ROQq1oQ6dUAJOUqVsRxYSLI3b4MQeS_grkNuLVr1MxijbUnKheO4lJTrXt0VDrg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1__2YHygNmJghODIvRyh3bpC9GnrifLUU06zlKRLgM_I3rl8NW8MRX2fWokeOznG92PhquIr8IWDRtQR3GbSy-BrqbJlXC51VvJAExaPvRrvrQON88eVjTEgEJ8M8_E8-gMniHmFJTpsASeBBq2YR_KESdq6CLP2K4WYlgHEsw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXX_nsvpOCxQ-RFFlc3QTbVgNGol-X71yY-k9-ytmqJEaWO5AjQE4CmOBMqkefoDN6K7zx44esvOSVWobD5jz7Otyn-V-vEiCwkfv2A811-WtqOPLm3qNg8-ryMbtO-JNivKlBM5X2PiszUL173vunKNg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXWVBBKWdIRlLuyeiql0LRqzbCkcrA14XFZZneY3uI6kevxz50zvZLTsiDmEmiBQUkyKn1XANE72qato5XOkk9jsCISoEPlICHNzCY4_6AdX63wljuevFXfgOmpeAoy7pz09p5XV9u29c3ymvEhfl1VLiw9U-IMqTr)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXi5IfWxRkXW3O64IeKOmfCvsCSrHP4XLwRzkKLEJ-AnMBpl9eFUdco7tXOKNtLiAZ19OeD5WmYLvPaxT5JlJeh5Boy3RO1BZtRaCVbm4BX5nTG82YXX5dLZcJKzDcJE3Y2nxrCwYOmg)
